ownedClauses.text: - **Storage outcome is measured.** Saved settings use this browser's storage. If writing is unavailable, changes still apply for the current session and Settings shows a retained warning. A partition can be writable and retain settings within that partition. Saving and persistence depend on the host's actual storage permissions and lifetime; blocked writes cause the session-only warning.
ownedClauses.scope: Persistence, Reset, conditional host/storage facts only; adjacent peer location/privacy prose not re-reviewed.

ownedClauses.text: - **Reset scope.** Reset removes only the saved widget configuration (`salah_widget:config:v1`); it does not erase prayer/weather caches or data held by external providers. Successful removal may re-detect the area and issue the coarse request above. Failed removal reports the failure and leaves the existing target usable.
ownedClauses.scope: Persistence, Reset, conditional host/storage facts only; adjacent peer location/privacy prose not re-reviewed.

ownedClauses.text: - **TablissNG conditions.** Coarse acquisition depends on permitted provider access; browser position depends on preserved delegation, parent policy and user grant; saving depends on writable host storage and its lifetime. These conditions are not a claim that a particular TablissNG version or partition policy has been qualified.
